en.t: The mountain was not high, nor was it very deep.

units.source_text: 山巅上整整齐齐地排列着的一棵棵杉树，仿佛一抬头就可望及。

en.t: The cedar trees standing neatly in rows on the mountaintop seemed as if they could be seen simply by lifting one's head.

units.source_text: 这些杉木是用来修建茶室的，所以杉林的形态看上去也有茶室的情调。

en.t: These cedars were meant for building tea rooms, so even the shape of the cedar grove seemed to have the atmosphere of a tea room.
